topics.topic: TypeScript's baseUrl is being dropped in TypeScript 7
topics.angle: Most devs assume tsconfig's baseUrl still resolves their imports, but TypeScript is removing it entirely in version 7, and paths needs to come along for the ride.
topics.why: This is the single highest-traffic item across all candidates at 25,265 views on one Stack Overflow question, a strong signal that developers are confused about a basic config option disappearing.

topics.topic: Full Rust rewrite vs. porting just the slow 5%

topics.why: Two brand-new Rust-rewrite tools picked up a combined 11,000+ GitHub stars in under two weeks, and a dev.to post about rewriting a TypeScript tool in Rust is getting the same discussion, the same idea surfacing in three independent sources.

topics.topic: Should you .gitignore a lockfile like uv.lock?
topics.angle: Devs reflexively gitignore uv.lock the way they gitignore node_modules, but the lockfile is exactly the file you're supposed to commit for reproducible installs.
topics.why: This question pulled over 5,500 views in about a month, more traffic than most dependency-lock questions get, pointing to real confusion about what belongs in version control.

topics.topic: setState inside a React effect cascading into more renders
topics.angle: A component kept re-rendering for no visible reason, and the fix was realizing that calling setState synchronously inside an effect can trigger React's cascading-render warning.
topics.why: The question reached nearly 4,900 views quickly, a common enough React effect pitfall to walk through step by step.

topics.topic: Git never stores a file's modification time
topics.angle: Developers assume Git remembers exactly when they last edited a file, but Git has never stored file timestamps at all, only content and the commit's own metadata.
topics.why: A Stack Overflow question on trying to preserve a file's exact mtime inside a repo shows developers are still surprised by this core Git behavior.

topics.topic: Tailwind's Vite plugin breaks on a fresh Vite 8 install
topics.angle: Installing Tailwind's official Vite plugin on a brand-new Vite 8 project throws a peer-dependency error because the plugin's version range hasn't caught up yet, and there's a one-line override that unblocks it.
topics.why: A fresh Stack Overflow question on exactly this version mismatch is gaining traction as developers upgrade ahead of the plugin's own release cadence.
